event.label: Milngin Ward replacement by-election
event.status: Nominations open; close noon ACST on 20 November
event.dateBasis: NTEC confirms nominations opened 9 November and close at noon on 20 November. Early voting runs from 8 am on 23 November to 6 pm on 2 December. Postal vote application deadlines are 6 pm on 29 November for overseas applications and 6 pm on 1 December for local applications. Election day voting is 8 am to 6 pm on 3 December. Completed postal ballots are due at noon on 16 December. Declaration is scheduled for 10 am on 17 December. All times are ACST.
event.contestantNote: Follow NTEC for published nominations after the close. The official notice confirms nominations are open.
